name: io.github.deepwired/mcp-jira-scoped
description: Jira MCP server with scoped API tokens via the api.atlassian.com gateway — server-side scope enforcement, toolset gating, and project allowlisting

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_USER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email associated with the API token

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated scopes the server may use. Classic (read:jira-work, write:jira-work, read:jira-user, read:me) or granular (read:issue:jira, ...). Defaults to read:jira-work. Unrecognised values fail at startup.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_CLOUD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian Cloud ID (auto-fetched if not set). Find at https://yoursite.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated capability groups to register: core, users, attachments, links, worklogs, metadata, agile, versions, filters, labels. Also accepts 'default' and 'all'. Defaults to the six core groups (34 tools).

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional allowlist of project keys (e.g. 'PROJ,OPS'). Requests naming other projects are refused before any API call and JQL is constrained server-side.
